DataPropertyAssertion.Literal: OWLlink request-type coverage. One test per OWLlink request type: boolean requests use kt:expectedResult, result-set requests use an expected response document (kt:expectedFile). All requests share the same small ontology so the expected answers are easy to verify by hand.
Same request over the live OWLlink server.
The values of a data property for an individual with an asserted value.
The values of a data property that are asserted for a sub-property of the queried property.
The values of a data property that follow from a DataHasValue class assertion of the individual.
The values of a data property from an asserted sub-property value and a DataHasValue class assertion of the same individual.
A data property value query for an individual without any value of the queried data property.
The value of a data property that is asserted for an individual that is the same individual as the queried individual.
The value of a data property that is derived from the TBox: the individual has a class that is a subclass of a DataHasValue restriction.
Only the values of the queried individual are answered, not those of other individuals.
Two values of a data property that are asserted for a sub-property of the queried property.
Values of different datatypes (string, integer, decimal, boolean) are answered with their datatypes.

An individual that is a member of a union whose branches require different data values has no entailed value, so the answer is empty (negative test: do not answer values that only hold in one branch).
A datatype facet restriction (xsd:integer with minInclusive 5) does not name a value, so no value is answered (negative test).
A functional data property with one asserted value answers exactly that value.
An ontology loaded with LoadOntologies from a file next to the request (relative file IRI) provides the data property value.
Both branches of a union require the same data value, so the value is entailed.
Both branches of a union force the same data value, but through different restriction kinds (hasValue and minimum cardinality with a literal-only range); the value is answered.
A minimum cardinality restriction with a literal-only data range forces the value.
A maximum cardinality restriction with a literal-only data range together with the asserted value answers the asserted value.

The data property synsets of an individual: an asserted data property, the super-property of an asserted value and the data property of a TBox-derived value; owl:topDataProperty is part of the answer.
The data property synsets between an individual and a literal: the directly asserted data property and the super-property that inherits the value.
The data property synset between an individual and a TBox-derived literal.
The data property synsets of a literal over all named individuals: the direct data property and the super-property that inherits the value.
The individual synsets that have a value for a data property; individuals that are the same individual are returned as one synset.
The sources of a super-property include the individuals whose value is asserted for a sub-property.
The data property of a TBox-derived value is part of the synsets of an individual without asserted data values.
A literal that does not occur in the ontology yields an empty source answer instead of a query error.
The individuals that have a value for a data property, flattened (without individual synsets).
The negative flag of GetDataPropertySources returns the named individuals that are not sources of the data property for the literal.
